name: TwitchClips
short: Auto-post new Twitch clips to a Discord channel.
description: Polls the Twitch Helix API for new clips on configured Twitch channels and posts them to a chosen Discord channel.
install_msg:
Set Twitch API credentials with: [p]set api twitch client_id,YOUR_ID client_secret,YOUR_SECRET
Then: [p]twitchclips add <twitch_user> #channel
author: James
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Twitch channel names and Discord channel IDs configured per server. It does not store personal user data.
